name: Hoshiyomi Mashiro
source:
Role: Witch
Breast: Small

A genius witch who is a new member of gardening club. Usually shows no emotion but surprisingly has "poisonous" tongue. The cat on the top of her cat is a demonic spirit named Bastet.

When the magic and fortune telling she does succeeded, she would wanting a praise and getting one will makes her posing a cute girl expression.
